description: A single sagittal image from a CT of the brain demonstrates a heterogeneous slightly hyperdense mass above the bulk of the cerebellum and posterior to the midbrain. Pineal calcifications are displaced superiorly and the mass is clearly below the internal cerebral veins / vein of Galen.
